business_problem: TeamSystem aimed to embed AI for smooth content access on a secure, scalable platform; choosing MongoDB Atlas unified data and boosted innovation.
solution_summary: TeamSystem aimed to embed AI for smooth content access on a secure, scalable platform; choosing MongoDB Atlas unified data and boosted innovation. TeamSystem combined full-text, metadata and vector search using MongoDB Atlas for precise, secure AI-powered queries. Based in Italy, with a portfolio of more than 300 products, a workforce of 4,800+, and expansion into markets such as Spain, France, Turkey, and Denmark, TeamSystem is driving digital transformation across European business. In 2024, TeamSystem launched a five-year R&D plan to embed AI deeply into its product ecosystem, focusing on real user needs. “There’s a lot of hype around AI, we wanted to be more pragmatic,” says Gianluca Genga, AI & Platform Engineering Manager, TeamSystem. However, with such a vast and expanding product catalog, silos of data and fragmented workflows made maximizing AI’s benefits challenging.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind TeamSystem's AI-powered search and assistant experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs.
business_outcome: TeamSystem built a high-performance, scalable AI platform for 500K users that cuts task times by 40%, boosts productivity, and simplifies data management.
metrics: TeamSystem is a leading provider of digital management solutions, trusted by over 2.5 million customers across Europe, from freelancers to major corporations and across diverse industries.

By leveraging MongoDB Atlas’s automatic horizontal scaling, TeamSystem has taken the platform from an initial pilot of 50,000 users to half a million, without compromising search performance or latency.
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for semantic or generative-AI use cases.
AI agents or assistants are layered on top of the MongoDB data platform.
